note: The script asks for the hook text, a number pop and a name super, so 3 graphics and the end card. The top CTA banner is the approved design file and is not rebuilt here (its words live in the approved version).

mg.title: Hook text
mg.cue: Hook text on frame 1: How much reaches the patient?
mg.use: Start the clip at frame 0045 (fully on) and hold it until 00:02. Top third, under the banner.

mg.title: Number pop
mg.use: On her word “100%” at the start of the row. 1.6 s, then gone. Under the banner.

mg.title: Name super
mg.use: Put it on 2 s into the row, after the number pop. Move it lower left, above the captions. Type the second line Executive Director, Watsi under it.

mg.title: End card
mg.cue: Two lines, Lato, navy #2E2844: 100% of your donation funds life-changing healthcare. then watsi.org, all lowercase.
mg.src: Watsi's own end card words from the script (watsi.org, the Who Gives close, or the Watsi x AYH lines). Watsi's scripts say no logo lockup. Source: endcards/index.json, 6 Oct 2026.
